title: 74 Elysee Court | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Professional Interior Design + Private Pool Just Steps From Beach!
description_expanded: Description: 74 Elysee Court by Royal Destinations Location: Gated, South of 30A, Santimo in Seacrest Beach (Between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach) Address: 74 Elysee Court, Inlet Beach, FL 32461 Details: Nestled between the highly coveted 30A communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, 74 Elysee Court is a perfectly positioned in the Gulf side private, community of Santimo. With over 5,600 square feet of modern, Gulf side luxury, this 30A luxury home boasts a pristine, private beach. Whether you are taking a dip in the private pool or escaping to one of the multiple private suites, this is the vacation of a lifetime. There is an abundance of outdoor living that can be enjoyed around the generous pool lanai. Guests searching for 30A vacation rentals south of 30A with private pools are sure to be wowed. The interior of the home is no less spectacular with massive spaces to spread out or gather together. The only thing missing is you! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 1 Minute Walk From Beach Access -Over 5,600 Sq Ft -Impeccable Interior Design -Parking Spaces: (4) in Driveway, (1) in Garage -Dining Accommodations: 8 At Dining Table, 4 At Kitchen Island -*Private Heated Pool *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 6 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths First Floor: -Pool Lanai with Grill -Chefs Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area / Smart TV -Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub), Smart TV -Bedroom 2: King Bed, Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) -Bedroom 3: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower), Smart TV -Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bath (Shower) -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Bedroom 5: King Bed, Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 6 Bunk Room, Two Twin/Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bath (Shower) -Family Room, Game Table, Smart TV Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March - October *A complimentary second beach set may be available, depending on availability. Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
